full_judgment:
. . . 2.(1) There shall be levied and collected by the provincial Government development relief tax from every tenant at the rate of four annas on each rupee of rent payable by him in respect of the land comprised in his tenancy with effect from the 1st day of Baishakh, 1362. Provided that when such land is held free of rent, such development and relief tax shall be levied and collected at the rate of four annas on each rupee of rent that would be assessable on such land on the principles laid down in section 26 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act,1950. 

 In 1951 a comprehensive legislation was promulgated in East Bengal, which is now Bangladesh, in the shape of The East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
